- Pull last 3 months of transactions. What are members ACTUALLY buying? (Classes, PT sessions, packages, add-ons?) List every SKU/offering, even the messy ones. This isn't about what you *think* you offer — it's about what's generating income. Build your menu from actual demand, not theory.

- **Member version**: Clean, benefit-focused copy (e.g., "Personal Training: Get a custom strength program + weekly check-ins") + pricing. Remove jargon.

# The Forge — Fractional CFO Action Plan

## **REVENUE — URGENT PRIORITY**

• **Member quality has collapsed.** Rev/member dropped from £145 (July) → £108 (October). Your active base grew 121→165 (+36%), but revenue fell £19.8k→£17.8k (−10%). You're onboarding low-value members or losing high-payers. Audit: who joined Aug–Oct, what plan tier, what churn rate? Likely culprits are intro discounts or low-retention budget tiers. **Action: raise entry price by 15% starting next month; offer 3-month commitment discount (not month-to-month) to new joiners.**

• **Churn spiked to 12.8% in May then stabilised at 4–6%.** The May spike (12.8%) correlates with the studio move; you've recovered well. However, **6.2% churn (Sept) is still 2× safer baseline.** This suggests post-move cohort quality or onboarding friction. **Action: map churn by cohort (pre-move vs post-move members); run a lapsed-member survey (email last 20 churned members) to identify friction points—class times, instructor quality, facilities complaint.**

• **Peak revenue was Sept at £22k; Oct dropped 19% to £17.8k.** This isn't seasonal noise—it's a revenue cliff. Missing data for Nov–Dec suggests either financial distress or reporting breakdown. **Action: immediately reconcile Oct–Dec actual cash in and revenue; if Nov–Dec were weak, urgent upsell campaign needed (retail, PT packages, class passes for non-members, corporate partnerships).**

• **Target: £22k+ monthly by Jan 2027.** To reach that at current churn, you need **40–50 new members/month at £140+ ARPU.** Current onboarding is running 20–30/month at £106. Double intake or raise ARPU. **Action: launch referral scheme (£50 credit per referral) and corporate wellness pilot (2–3 local employers, 8–10 member discount packages).**

---

## **EXPENSES — STRUCTURAL VIEW NEEDED**

• **No expense data provided, so can't diagnose cost creep after the move.** A bigger studio (relocation in April) will have higher rent, utilities, insurance, cleaning. **Action: pull last 3 months' P&L from accounting software (rent, payroll, utilities, insurance, supplies). Flag any expense >£8k/month as a pressure point.**
